rules.title: Santa Monica Rent Control: Maximum Allowable Rent, annual General Adjustment, registration-fee pass-through and property-tax surcharges
rules.requirement: Rent in controlled units is limited to the Maximum Allowable Rent (MAR), which rises by an annual General Adjustment (3.0% effective September 1, 2024). Owners who pay the registration fee on time may pass half through as a monthly surcharge ($9.50 for 2024/25). For tenancies that started before March 1, 2018, owners may pass through limited property-tax items, capped at $35 or 4% of the MAR, whichever is less.
rules.citation: Santa Monica Rent Control Law (Maximum Allowable Rent, registration fee and surcharge pass-throughs)
citation_aliases: Santa Monica Rent Control Board General Adjustment History & Surcharges
rules.quoted_span: The total monthly pass-through of the five line items from the owner’s property tax bill may not exceed $35 or 4% of the 2024/2025 MAR, whichever is less.
rules.effective_date_note: The document gives no effective date for the underlying law. The 2024 General Adjustment took effect September 1, 2024.
rules.key_value: General Adjustment 3.0% (2024); surcharge cap $35 or 4% of MAR, whichever is less
rules.exemptions: The document does not list exemptions. The General Adjustment does not apply to units whose tenancy started on or after September 1 of the prior year. Property-tax surcharges apply only to tenancies that started before March 1, 2018. They end if the property is reassessed on or after March 1, 2018 because of a sale or voluntary improvements. Low-income tenants may have the tax surcharge waived.

unverifiable_exemptions: owner age 65+ exemption from school parcel tax
